chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿUdhāfir, from someone he mentioned, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about temporary marriage with virgins. He said: “Was that made except for them? So let them be discreet about it and let them observe chastity.”

key_terms.التَّمَتُّعِ: temporary marriage (mutʿah) being asked about in the narration
key_terms.الْأَبْكَارِ: virgins, the category of women mentioned in the legal question
key_terms.جُعِلَ: was made or legislated, indicating permissibility or allowance
key_terms.فَلْيَسْتَتِرْنَ: let them be discreet or conceal it, indicating modest reserve
key_terms.وَ لْيَسْتَعْفِفْنَ: and let them observe chastity, showing moral restraint

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about temporary marriage with virgins?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of temporary marriage with virgins and affirms its applicability in this context. It also emphasizes modesty, discretion, and chastity in such matters, combining a legal ruling with ethical restraint.
